verdict.rationale: Termius clearly supports managing many hosts/groups with per-host settings, keychain credentials, and automatically logs each session's history (searchable, synced) and can broadcast commands across simultaneous sessions—implying multiple independent session contexts. However, the evidence pack lacks any explicit mention of per-session appearance/theme customization, and community reports cite performance/UI issues (slow scrolling, buggy Windows client) that would degrade a heavy multi-session workflow.
